_source: Trimmed from each state's real Enhanced Voting /api/elections/{jurisdiction}/{id}/data response, fetched 2026-09-28 by the live-results review: every federal ballot item (ballot options cut to name/party/votes/write-in flags), two non-federal decoys each, localityElections cut to id + isProduction (their COUNT is what unit_label reads), and the election envelope's scalar fields. UT/VA/GA are real GENERAL elections (2024; GA also 2022, whose House labels mix two formats). WA/ID/RI hold no general yet (their indexes start in 2026), so their entry is the real 2026 primary: the label formats their general will print, verified the same way. WA's also carries one statewide non-federal contest (Supreme Court Position 1, 39 of 39 counties), because its 2026 ballot has no Senate race and unit_label is read off a statewide contest.
